items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-10-21
items.q: I know Israel Gorman, he played, he was pretty good on me.

ctx.x: Um, when you started playing clarinet, did all the clarinetists in New Orleans play Albert's system? Never. All of them. Were there, were the BAME systems around at that time?

I don't, I never saw him in the, I don't say, I never saw him. I know Israel Gorman, he played, he was pretty good on me. And then, at that time, he played Albert. Uh, uh, that is Cherie. That is Cherie, he played Albert. Uh, Zell, Zell, uh, Alondrie, which is, his niece, uh, lives around the corner there. He played Albert. George Abort, he played Albert. Uh, he, he also, and a lot of other fellas I know played Albert. Yeah. Uh, I use, I use the BAME system once, twice.
Why did you ever use a BAME system? Hmm? Why did you ever use a BAME system?

items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: Yes, George Lewis and his wife, Jeannette. McGee. And McGee was my best man of drummer. McGee. Jim Clark, Kid Harbor, all the musicians, most musicians at the wedding.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. We just lived together. Bill Rossman. Yeah, we're watching.

Yeah, actually, for all the nice boys and David Wyckoff, they were the ones who put up the money for the kids, I remember now. Let's see. Maybe I can get you to turn it off for a minute now, okay? Off. Time to start off. I don't know. Oh, no, I haven't been to Florida. Have you been to Florida? Where are you from? I'm from Florida. What part? Pensacola. Pensacola? Yeah. Can I embarrass you? What's your age? Now, what year were you born in? 1970. Born in 1970 over there? And what's your exact birthday? June the…

See? What are they calling you now? It's from the Boudoir. It has to be from the Boudoir. That's my handle. That's the handle you put on that. Well, the Boudoir, you see, I'm going to show you a lot of people don't know what a Boudoir is. You see, when I came down here from Memphis, you see, and I was cigarette test up there, and you go in there and smoke and test them cigarettes. That's what you call a Boudoir.
